title: Owner approval binds only to a commit the owner actually saw
acceptance: A push that races the owner's label cannot leave the owner-approval status on a commit the owner never saw.
Re-running an earlier labeled run after the owner removed owner-approved cannot turn the required check green.
nextAction: Owner decides whether to harden further (for example, bind to the reviewed SHA named in the approval) given per-PR merge permission is the backstop.

evidence.summary: Final review #4 of #643 (finding 6): the status lands on head.sha at label time, so a racing push can be bound; a rerun of an old labeled run reuses its payload. Non-blocking under the significance rule; logged 2026-10-27.
